The Unseen Half: Transforming Transplant Advocacy Through Care Partner Integration

Mental Health as Clinical Infrastructure, Outcome-Aligned Systems Design, and the Lean Six Sigma Case for Structural Reform

Abstract

The transplant care partner remains the healthcare system’s most consequential unmeasured variable. Approximately 500,000 individuals in the United States perform mandatory clinical-grade care labor as a condition of transplant listing — labor structurally invisible in cost accounting, excluded from governance frameworks, and absent from outcome measurement systems. Drawing on published meta-analyses, this paper makes the evidence-based case for four structural interventions and applies a Lean Six Sigma DMAIC framework to establish specific process capability targets for the transformed system.
